launch_condition: Do not consume fresh seeds until all R87D5 host/profile cohorts and repeats have completed and the portable_v1 cross-host scientific-output/state comparison passes. If R87D5 fails, stop; no changed-profile rescue under this protocol.
H: Under the fixed portable_v1 numeric profile and unchanged original digits replacement grammar, composed-span replacement selects a smaller passing parameter budget than component-wise replacement while selected test accuracy is noninferior within2 percentage points.

T.data: Original fixed sklearn digits train1077/validation270/test450 split; no data-driven retuning. Model seeds are new, dataset is not independent.
T.numeric_profile: R87D5 portable_v1: float32 original science, ATenAVX2, MKL_CBWR=COMPATIBLE, oneDNN disabled, deterministic algorithms enabled, one intra/inter-op thread; identical primary package pins and recorded actual hardware.
T.model_and_fitting: Original four-block width64 Residual-MLP, first-two-block replacement, exact budget grid512/1024/1536/2048/3072/4096/6144, 600 mapping updates/batch128; no loss64 intervention.
T.selection: First candidate in original grid with validation NMSE<=0.08 and accuracy>=teacher_validation_accuracy-0.02. Test metrics are never selection variables; original runner computes teacher test accuracy and evaluates replacement test accuracy only when its validation endpoint is first selected. The fixed2048 mechanistic control also reports test; it is not a primary gate.
T.bootstrap_method: paired model-seed percentile95, common index matrix; no optional stopping, replacement or cohort expansion
T.execution: Two separately provisioned GitHub hosts run the same16 seeds; host a is the prospectively named scientific cohort, host b is a technical replication, not16 additional independent seeds. Exact original/instrumented known1202 bridge precedes each. Host data/init/RNG/state hashes and outcomes compared without tolerance; all raw records retained.

D.integrity: Any missing/duplicate/malformed/nonfinite seed or missing selected endpoint => STOP_INTEGRITY_OR_UNSELECTED_ENDPOINT; no seed exclusions.
D.primary: PASS if upper95 of mean log2(B_composed/B_componentwise)<0; FAIL if lower95>0; otherwise UNCERTAIN.
D.secondary: PASS if lower95 of mean(test_acc_composed-test_acc_componentwise)>-0.02; FAIL if upper95<-0.02; otherwise UNCERTAIN.
D.science: R87R1_CONFIRMATORY_PASS only if both locked scientific gates PASS on host a; otherwise report the separate FAIL/UNCERTAIN status without changing thresholds.
D.technical: TESTED_HOST_EXACT_REPLICATION_PASS only if all16 original outcome objects and data/init/RNG/training hashes are identical across hosts. A scientific PASS does not erase technical failure.
D.historical: No replacement of historical1200-1207 numbers. No claim of restoring the original producing environment. No automatic Issue87 closure, main scientific promotion, release or public announcement.

C: Fixed-profile fresh models may not show the old directional effect.
A portable profile may align endpoints on known seeds but fail on fresh models.
The fixed task and span may drive the finding; no architecture or dataset generality.
U: Bootstrap measures model-seed variation conditional on one dataset/split.
No theorem of cross-platform floating-point identity.
Parameter budget is not runtime, memory, energy or measured FLOPs.
Historical execution provenance remains separately unresolved unless recovered.
